rules: Run packed-w1 first for every representative workload.
Measure packed workers=1/2/4/6/8 as separate single-job experiments; record every tier even when a higher tier is not eligible for policy selection.
Use actual hosted runner CPU/RAM and prior-tier stability as selection gates; a failed gate forbids selecting the higher tier but does not erase its measurement evidence.
Do not run hosted shards for focused/targeted work solely to increase parallelism.
Do not maximize workers and shards simultaneously; isolate the two parallelism axes before combined experiments are proposed.
Compare axes deliberately rather than materializing a Cartesian matrix.
No candidate in this file selects production policy; final calibration is a later protected post-Phase-D decision.
